# HireWise

> AI-powered interview preparation platform. Daily coding challenges, mock interviews with live confidence scoring, resume feedback, and a composite readiness score.

HireWise helps engineers prepare for technical interviews with a curated question bank, AI mock interviewer, AI resume analysis, and progress tracking. Public profiles let candidates share their prep signal with recruiters.
